title: Research on Drosophila melanogaster and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine
summary: This cluster is centered around research on Drosophila melanogaster, a type of fruit fly, and its relation to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, a chemical compound. Oksana Tehlivets is involved in the conceptualization and funding acquisition of this research, which was conducted in Austria. Jutta Hafner wrote about the investigation of Drosophila melanogaster, while Markus S. Brunner was responsible for data curation related to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. Other researchers, including Hansjörg Habisch and Jenkins, are also part of this cluster, but their roles are not specified. The research was likely conducted at various institutions, including the University of Graz and Medical University of Graz.
